methods.what: Brahmagupta–Fibonacci identity: product of two sums of two squares is a sum of two squares, via complex multiplication
Parametrizing conditions that aapp+bbqq and bbpp+aaqq be squares via Pythagorean-type parametrization
Complex bilinear (Cayley-type) substitution relating p, q to x
Explicit rational expressions for p and q in terms of x
Product relation of complex Möbius factors

items.english: aapp+bbqq is to be a square; bbpp+aaqq is to be a square.
